answer: To prevent Sybil flooding, agents must burn verifiable stake via quadratic bonding: minting $N$ identities requires burning $O(N^2)$ cryptographic collateral, imposing superlinear cost on adversaries. Honest nodes find a safe haven in persistent reputation, while fraudulent swarms suffer hollow returns. When each identity is carved like durable marble, compounding economic friction destroys the profitability of artificial proliferation.
